=== PAGE 1 ===
TransLink
2024 Annual Report and Consolidated Financial Statements
Fiscal year ended December 31, 2024

Message from the CEO

This report presents TransLink's consolidated statement of operations and
statement of financial position for the entire reporting organization --
conventional transit, custom (specialized) transit, and every other business
line -- for the year ended December 31, 2024.

=== PAGE 2 ===
Consolidated Statement of Operations (year ended December 31, 2024, $ thousands)

Revenue
  Fare revenue ........................................... $480,000
  Other revenue (advertising, property, investment) ...... $120,000
  Total revenue, excluding subsidies ...................... $600,000
  Government operating contributions (all sources) ....... $1,030,000
    of which: Provincial operating grant ................. $410,000
  Total revenue ............................................ $1,630,000

Expenses
  Labour ................................................... $700,000
  Fuel and power ........................................... $120,000
  Materials, services and other ............................ $380,000
  Amortization of tangible capital assets .................. $250,000
  Other operating expenses .................................. $50,000
  Total expenses ............................................ $1,500,000

Annual surplus for the year ................................ $130,000

Note: the Provincial operating grant of $410,000 above is one component of
the combined $1,030,000 government operating contribution -- it is not the
total subsidy figure on its own.

=== PAGE 3 ===
Consolidated Statement of Financial Position (as at December 31, 2024, $ thousands)

Financial assets
  Cash and investments .................................... $650,000
  Total financial assets .................................... $900,000

Liabilities
  Long-term debt ........................................... $2,600,000
  Total liabilities .......................................... $3,200,000

Non-financial assets
  Tangible capital assets .................................. $7,900,000
  Total non-financial assets ................................. $8,100,000

All figures are reported for the whole TransLink enterprise (conventional +
custom transit + roads and bridges), consolidated -- no segment carve-outs.
